notes: The version is the date this ruleset last changed, and it is what lands in
packages.service_ruleset_version. Bump it whenever any table in this directory
changes, so an inference recorded under an older ruleset can be recognised and
re-derived. Each table carries its own upstream provenance and effective date.
Versions compare as strings because they are ISO dates; a package whose stamp
sorts below this one was inferred under an older ruleset.

tables.usps-impb-stc.json: USPS IMpb Service Type Codes, used by the tracking-number rung
tables.ups-1z-service-indicator.json: UPS service level indicators, used by the tracking-number rung
tables.label-tokens.json: Service tokens printed on label plaintext, used by the label rung
